opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK, with a ‘Good’ regulator rating; project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital cost ≥ £50,000 and shortfall ≥ £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects that improve independence for people with disability, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities in the UK, with a ‘Good’ regulator rating; project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital cost ≥ £50,000 and shortfall ≥ £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities delivering mental health services, emphasizing training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities or local authorities with a ‘Good’ regulator rating; project must be new build, refurbishment or equipment with capital cost ≥ £50,000 and shortfall ≥ £25,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital funding for organisations providing care for older people, especially those with neuro‑degenerative conditions or isolation.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities or local authorities managing historic sites of national significance; must be open to the public and meet listed building criteria.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation, restoration and interpretation of historic buildings, monuments and landscapes, with a focus on public access.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or NHS‑operated hospices in the UK; must have a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment to improve hospice and palliative care services.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities or local authorities operating nationally significant libraries or archives, accredited and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital funding for new build, refurbishment or equipment to improve access to nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities or local authorities operating museums or galleries with nationally significant collections, accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment to improve display and interpretation of nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities or local authorities whose primary activity is professional performing arts; must have a ‘Good’ regulator rating where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK charities, local authorities or universities with nationally significant scientific or natural‑history collections, accredited where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment to improve public engagement with science through the history of science.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered or exempt charities or local authorities providing special education for secondary‑age students; must have a ‘Good’ regulator rating.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment to develop skills for independent living and employment for young people with special educational needs.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK research‑intensive universities or research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research.
opportunities.summary: Capital funding for new buildings, refurbishment or major equipment to enhance research infrastructure and, where relevant, public engagement with science.
